title: Jawir thiyankir uñjir alma
intro: Mä wayna almaruw mä jamasat misión churapxäna, jan kuna jan walt’äwin jaya chiqat uñjañatakiwa, kunjams destinox uma patxan uñstaski. Jan uñjkaya ukat jan suytʼasaw uka jakhüwijj mä markan sarnaqäwip mayjtʼayañatakejj wali wakiskirïspa.
clues: Mamajaw mä luraw churitäna, uka lurañajj jamasat ukat amuyasiñaw wakisïna.
Nayranakajajj mä jiskʼa cunaruw arktäna, uka cunajj uma taypin jalnaqäna, chuymajajj llakimp llaktʼatänwa.
Kunapachatï mä jan suytʼat fiestan jikjjatapkäna ukhajja, wali mulljataw jakʼachasta.
Mä uñjirir jan chʼamanïpjjatap uñjayäta, ukat jan cheq yatiyasajj mä askichäwi churayäta.
Tiempopar yanaptʼatajajj khititï jukʼamp munaskäna ukaruw mä enfermera almaruw kuttʼayäna.
Chʼamani jaqenakan tribunalanakapanjja, akham sasaw sista: ‘¿Mä familiar irpapjjäma, jupar manqʼa churapjjañapataki ukat sum uñjapjjañapataki?’ sasa.

location.label: Elemento Clave ukax mä juk’a pachanakanwa

arabic: ۞ وَحَرَّمْنَا عَلَيْهِ ٱلْمَرَاضِعَ مِن قَبْلُ فَقَالَتْ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَهْلِ بَيْتٍۢ يَكْفُلُونَهُۥ لَكُمْ وَهُمْ لَهُۥ نَـٰصِحُونَ
verse: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, "Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?" (28:12)
